title: Arrays & Skip Counting Worksheets | 2nd Math Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: 2.NBT.A.2, 2.OA.C.3, 2.OA.C.4

Give your learners extra practice with Arrays & Skip Counting! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Rows and Columns
  • Even or Odd?
  • Skip Counting by 2s, 5s and 10s
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
